name: add_strftime
description: Add a strftime format; it gets the next free id (f1, f2, …).

name: add_intl
description: Add an Intl format for a locale (dateStyle medium); it gets the next free id.

name: set_locale
description: Change an Intl format's locale (a BCP 47 tag).

name: set_intl_option
description: Set one option of an Intl format, or remove it with "". hour12 takes "true" or "false".

name: remove_format
description: Remove a strftime or Intl format.

name: add_instant
description: Add an instant from an ISO time (UTC when it has no offset); it gets the next free id (i1, …).

name: set_instant
description: Change an instant to an ISO time.

name: reorder_instants
description: Move an instant to index (0 is first): the order of the table's rows.

name: reorder_strftimes
description: Move a strftime format to index among the strftime formats (0 is first); they come before the Intl ones in the table's columns.

name: reorder_intls
description: Move an Intl format to index among the Intl formats (0 is first).

name: set_expectation
description: Set the output a format should give for an instant, or "" to clear it.

name: formatted
description: Every instant × format: the output, the expected output and whether it passes.

name: try_strftime
description: A strftime pattern applied to every instant, without saving it: { instant, text, errors }.

name: directives
description: The strftime directives this lab supports.
